cd_conj.doc: Return the Cayley-Dickson conjugate: negate every component except e₀.

cd_mul.doc:
Multiply two Cayley-Dickson elements by the doubling rule
(a₁, a₂)(b₁, b₂) = (a₁b₁ − conj(b₂)a₂,  b₂a₁ + a₂conj(b₁)).

params.b: coefficient vector of the same length

cd_mul.returns: the product, a vector of the same length

e_k.doc: Return the basis element eₖ as a coefficient vector.
e_k.returns: the vector with a 1 at index k and zeros elsewhere

sedenion_hole_punch.returns: dict describing the cavitation mechanism and its checks

nball_transformer.returns: dict with V(n) across the CD layers and the checks on it
